title: Base change detects a local-map pair by its universal overlap defect
statement: Let X and Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], U an open cover of X, F and G O_X-modules, r_x:F restricted to U_x -> G restricted to U_x a family of module morphisms, a,b chart indices, and q:Y -> X a scheme morphism [def-pc-module-pullback]. On W=U_a times_X U_b let g_a,g_b be the projections, t=g_a followed by U_a -> X, and D_F,D_G the canonical descent data of F,G. Define d:g_a^*(F|U_a) -> g_b^*(G|U_b) as g_a^*(r_a) followed by the transition of D_G minus the transition of D_F followed by g_b^*(r_b). Let pi:W times_X Y -> W be the first projection. On the base changed cover V let r^q_x=e_F inverse followed by (U.pullbackHom q x)^*(r_x) followed by e_G, where e is the canonical open-cover tensor-pullback comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]. Then PairCompatibility r^q a b [def-pc-local-map-pair-compatibility] holds if and only if pi^*(d)=0. No finiteness, quasi-coherence, affineness or limit hypothesis is required.

source.place: limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR (3), first proof by Zariski gluing; canonical pullback and pseudofunctor coherence

proof.text: Construct the universal test on W times_X Y with the two canonical chart lifts. Every other test factors through it by first lifting to W and then to W times_X Y. Check all three projection equations using pullback hom_ext. The proved private pairCompatibility_iff_test lemma reduces all-test compatibility to this universal test using descent pullHom_hom.

Use openCoverTensorDescentComparison_existsUnique to obtain the uniquely determined isomorphism comparisonObj with the prescribed chart hom and inverse maps. Its statement fixes all data up to equality (descent Hom extensionality and Iso.ext), so this use of Classical.choose is not a choice of arbitrary existence data. comparisonObj_components is proved from choose_spec and supplies both component equations without normalizing a composed natural-isomorphism construction.

The private square_conjugate_iff cancels the chart isomorphisms. square_pullFunctor_iff uses pullFunctorObjHom_eq and mapComp' naturality to identify the pulled square with the square for the original chart maps. square_pull_iff uses pullHom_hom and mapComp' naturality to identify this square with equality of the original composites pulled along the projection. Combine these equivalences with the universal-test criterion in universal_baseChange_square_iff.

Apply that categorical equivalence to the explicitly constructed universal chart maps and comparisonObj for F and G. Its chart projections identify the transported family definitionally. Pullback additivity (Functor.map_sub) and sub_eq_zero identify the equality of composites with vanishing of the explicit overlap defect.

lean.statement:
theorem localMapPairOverlapDefect_baseChange_iff
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (F G : X.Modules)
    (r₀ : ∀ x, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.f x)).obj F ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.f x)).obj G) (a b : U.I₀) (q : Y ⟶ X) :
    let W := pullback (U.f a) (U.f b)
    let t : W ⟶ X := pullback.fst (U.f a) (U.f b) ≫ U.f a
    let V := U.pullback₁ q
    let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData V.f
    let C := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q
    let r : ∀ x, (Q.obj (C.obj F)).obj x ⟶ (Q.obj (C.obj G)).obj x := fun x ↦
      let e := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q U x
      e.inv.app F ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q x)).map (r₀ x) ≫
        e.hom.app G
    Pseudofunctor.DescentData.PairCompatibility r a b ↔
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst t q)).map
        (localMapPairOverlapDefect U F G r₀ a b) = 0
